shortDescription: According to Sina Finance, informed traders said the Reserve Bank of India sold U.S. dollars in the local foreign exchange market to support the rupee. The dollar/Indian rupee rose 0.1% to 95.8750, while the rupee has fallen more than 6% this year and has underperformed most Asian currencies.
